title: Re-check DR-15: ext-10 §5 per-leaf safe_aad list
description: Decision mimid-1wgh.4.35 (DR-15) says mls-extensions-10 does not define a per-leaf Safe AAD support list, but ext-10 §5 (L887-890) defines the safe_aad component in a LeafNode as 'the list of supported components that use Safe AAD'. If DR-15 misread the draft, mimi-mls may be non-conformant (leaf advertisement and/or the check against the group's safe_aad). Re-read §4.9 and §5, compare with identity.rs/member.rs, and either reaffirm DR-15 with the reasoning or file a corrected decision plus a fix. Found by the 2026-10-17 errata sweep.
